en.title: Rome I, Croatian version: does Article 8(2) on employment contracts apply in the absence of a choice of law, as in the other versions?
en.summary: The other 23 versions open paragraph 2 with the absence of a choice by the parties. The Croatian opening repeats the condition of paragraph 3 and makes paragraph 2 depend on paragraph 2 itself. Croatian corrigenda 32008R0593R(04) and R(06) do not touch Article 8.
en.impact: For an employee who habitually works in one country under a contract without a choice of law, the Croatian text does not clearly state that the law of that country applies.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: open Croatian Article 8(2) with the absence of a choice of law by the parties, as in the other versions.

quote_translations.q1: If the applicable law cannot be determined on the basis of paragraph 2.

hr.title: Rim I, hrvatska verzija: primjenjuje li se članak 8. stavak 2. o ugovorima o radu kad stranke nisu izabrale mjerodavno pravo, kao u drugim verzijama?
hr.summary: Ostale 23 verzije započinju stavak 2. uvjetom da stranke nisu izabrale mjerodavno pravo. Hrvatski uvodni dio ponavlja uvjet iz stavka 3. i čini stavak 2. ovisnim o samom stavku 2. Hrvatski ispravci 32008R0593R(04) i R(06) ne mijenjaju članak 8.
hr.impact: Za zaposlenika koji uobičajeno izvršava svoj posao u jednoj državi na temelju ugovora bez izbora prava, hrvatski tekst ne navodi jasno da se primjenjuje pravo te države.
hr.correction: Pravnici lingvisti mogli bi reći treba li tekst uskladiti s drugim jezičnim verzijama: članak 8. stavak 2. hrvatske verzije započeti uvjetom da stranke nisu izabrale mjerodavno pravo, kao u drugim verzijama.

quotes.source: Regulation (EC) No 593/2008 (Rome I), Official Journal, Croatian version
quotes.text: Ako se mjerodavno pravo ne može utvrditi na temelju stavka 2.

translations.en: If the applicable law cannot be determined on the basis of paragraph 2.

quotes.source: Regulation (EC) No 593/2008 (Rome I), Official Journal, English version
quotes.text: To the extent that the law applicable to the individual employment contract has not been chosen by the parties
